verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: 10Y yield spike lifts money-center banks over regionals
cells.refutation: If money-center banks do not outperform regional banks after a 10Y yield spike, refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare money-center banks (JPM, BAC, C, WFC) vs regional banks (KRE constituents); money-centers should outperform if curve steepening is the driver.

cells.title: Equity issuance dilution read-through to cash-poor peers
cells.refutation: If cash-poor peers' next-session residual is not more negative than cash-rich matched peers (spread >= 0, t < 1), refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare cash-poor peers to cash-rich peers matched on size and beta; the cash-poor-minus-cash-rich residual spread should be negative.

cells.title: Clinical trial failure of one firm drags peers with similar pipeline
cells.refutation: If linked peers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked biotech firms over the next 2 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare peer basket return to a matched set of biotech firms with no pipeline overlap in that therapeutic area, controlling for market beta and sector return.
